svg.aria-label: Ananta at a Glance: One page for judges: the problem, the system, the Google tools it uses, and where each judging criterion is evidenced.
svg.text: Children often meet ideas they do not understand but hesitate to ask: embarrassment,
peer judgment, not knowing what to ask. A teacher cannot give every child unlimited
A voice-first adaptive tutor. The child can say “I don’t know” or “explain it differently”
without judgment. It checks understanding, not just answers, and changes how it
teaches when something does not land.
Not a replacement for the teacher. Gives private questioning, formative checks,
misconception detection and a parent-readable report between classes.
